title: Release `ia-design-base` and `ia-product-base` 0.1.1: accept sequential signer revisions in `check-design-patterns` and `check-prds`
summary: The bundled `ia-design-base` and `ia-product-base` kits move to 0.1.1, and `@inventarch/public-kits` to 1.2.1. Under a `current-revision` approval rule, their checkers now accept the revision each sequential signer captured with the earlier approvals already present, as `check-seal` does, so a quorum-2 seal that `check-seal` ratifies no longer fails as `ACTIVE_RECIPE_UNSEALED` or `PRD_UNSEALED`.
